description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003 (Amended) Direction under Section 10(1)(a)
categorisation: This gazette content contains a direction issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under Section 10(1)(a) of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes regulatory requirements for product labeling and pricing, which falls under legal/regulatory matters involving statutory instruments and compliance requirements. This does not involve government structure/personnel changes or any of the other specialized categories.
